sanskrit: tannaumi sāhasavaraṃ guruvaktragamyamko'pyanuttaracidvyomasvabhāvo jayatādajaḥpūjyapūjakapūjābhiḥ projjhitaṃ yannamāmi tatmahāvyomasamāviṣṭastisṭhāmyasminnirāvilaḥsaṃvidvikalpasaṃkalpaghaṭṭanaṃ naumyanuttaramkenāpi kriyate samyakparatattvopabṛṃhitāmahāsāhasavṛttyā svarūpalābhaḥvakṣyamāṇakathitakrameṇā-dhigantavyaḥsatatamavasthitiḥ sthitetyarthaḥḥprāptamahopadeśanāmāvirbhavatītyar-thaḥyugmagrāsānniravakāśasaṃvinniṣṭhānirupādhinīrūpaniḥsvarūpatādātmyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥsiddhayoginīsaṃghaṭṭānmahāmelāpodayaḥparamādvayasamāveśaḥ sarvatrāvasthita ityuktaṃ bhavatibhavatīti saṃbandhaḥyathāmukhopadiṣṭanītyā svara eva prathate, - ityuktaṃ bhavativigatabandhaṃ paraṃ brahmavibhātīti rahasyārthaḥsvaviśrāntyavasthitiḥvasthitiḥ pañcamapadātiśāyinī niravakāśasaṃvinniṣṭhā sthitetyarthaḥdvādaśavāhodayena mahāmarīcivikāsaḥtayā sarvatra sarvataḥ sarvadaiva sthita iti mahāvākyārthaḥcaryāpañcakodaye nistaraṅgasamāveśaḥcaryāpañcakodayaḥ
